reliability.title: Executor productivity
reliability.subtitle: How much each subscription delivered, at what success rate and at what cost — and where the system fails. Exact, estimated and unavailable tokens stay separate.
reliability.sampleTruncated: This project's history is larger than the sample read: the numbers below cover the most recent executions, not all of them.

noProject.body: Pick a project to see fleet productivity.

empty.title: No executions to measure yet
empty.body: Once the fleet runs missions in this project, productivity per subscription and pass@k show up here.

subscriptions.title: Per subscription
subscriptions.help: An account can succeed often and still consume disproportionately — success rate and usage sit side by side for that reason.

capabilities.title: Success per round (pass@k)
capabilities.help: pass@1 is getting it right first try; pass@k is getting it right within k attempts. The recommendation says how many rounds are worth spending before switching accounts.
capabilities.empty: Not enough executions yet to measure success per round.

intents.title: Leadership conversations, by topic
intents.help: Every conversation is classified by topic before it becomes action. The adjustments column shows how many times the system stopped a conversation from becoming work nobody asked for.
